children.label: a
children.prompt: Find where the two graphs intersect.

answer.worked:
The parabola is below the straight line to the left of $x=-2$ and to the right of $x=3$. The intersection values are excluded because the inequality is strict.
$$x<-2\quad\text{or}\quad x>3.$$
